name: N Candles v4
summary: N Candles v4 is a utility indicator/EA for MetaTrader 5 that counts and displays information about N consecutive candles (e.g., consecutive bullish or bearish candles) on the chart. It serves as a visual analytical tool to help traders identify streak patterns in candle sequences rather than executing trades automatically.
summary_zh: N Candles v4 是一个MetaTrader 5平台上的工具型指标/EA，用于计数和显示图表上N根连续K线（如连续阳线或阴线）的信息。它作为可视化分析工具帮助交易者识别K线序列中的连续形态，而非自动执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本质上是一个K线连续形态识别工具，而非自动交易策略。它通过统计连续同向K线（连续阳线或连续阴线）的数量来辅助交易者判断市场趋势强度和潜在反转点。入场条件方面，该EA不自行开仓，而是提供连续K线计数信息供交易者参考决策。出场条件同样不适用，因为该EA不管理任何持仓。仓位管理不涉及，因其仅作为信息展示工具。资金管理方面，该EA不涉及任何资金管理逻辑，仅专注于K线形态的统计与展示。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is fundamentally a candlestick streak pattern identification tool rather than an automated trading strategy. It counts consecutive same-direction candles (consecutive bullish or bearish candles) to help traders gauge trend strength and potential reversal points. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not open positions on its own but provides consecutive candle count information for traders to make reference decisions. Exit conditions are likewise not applicable since the EA does not manage any positions. Position sizing is not involved as it functions purely as an informational display tool. In terms of money management, the EA contains no money management logic whatsoever, focusing exclusively on the statistics and display of candlestick patterns.

parameters.name: N_Candles
parameters.description: 连续K线的数量参数，定义要检测的连续同向K线数量
parameters.description_en: Consecutive candle count for same-direction detection

parameters.name: Alert_On
parameters.description: 是否在检测到N根连续同向K线时发出警报
parameters.description_en: Alert on N consecutive same-direction candles

parameters.name: Show_Panel
parameters.description: 是否在图表上显示信息面板

parameters.name: Candle_Body_Ratio
parameters.description: K线实体占比阈值，用于判断阳线或阴线的最小实体比例
parameters.description_en: Min body ratio threshold for bullish/bearish candle

pros: 作为辅助分析工具，帮助交易者快速识别连续K线形态，提高形态识别效率
提供可视化面板和警报功能，方便交易者实时监控市场连续K线情况
不自动交易，交易者可完全掌控交易决策，降低自动化风险
可用于多品种多周期分析，具备良好的灵活性
概念简单直观，适合各类交易者使用
pros_en: As an analytical辅助 tool, it helps traders quickly identify consecutive candlestick patterns, improving pattern recognition efficiency
Provides a visual panel and alert functionality for real-time monitoring of consecutive candlestick situations in the market
Does not auto-trade, allowing traders full control over trading decisions, reducing automation risk
Can be used for multi-instrument and multi-timeframe analysis with good flexibility
Simple and intuitive concept, suitable for all types of traders
cons: 不自动执行交易，仅提供参考信息，对希望全自动化交易的用户价值有限
缺乏与交易策略的集成能力，无法直接将识别结果转化为交易信号
参数可能有限，无法自定义更复杂的K线形态检测规则
作为工具型EA，无法进行回测验证其形态识别的实际交易价值
依赖视觉展示，在多图表环境下可能造成信息过载
cons_en: Does not auto-execute trades, only provides reference information, limiting value for users seeking fully automated trading
Lacks integration with trading strategies, cannot directly convert identification results into trade signals
Parameters may be limited, unable to customize more complex candlestick pattern detection rules
As a utility EA, it cannot be backtested to verify the actual trading value of its pattern recognition
Relies on visual display, which may cause information overload in multi-chart environments
improvements: 增加与交易策略的集成接口，允许将连续K线形态识别结果直接转化为交易信号
添加更多K线形态检测功能，如吞没形态、十字星等经典形态
improvements_en: Add integration interface with trading strategies to allow consecutive candlestick pattern recognition results to directly generate trade signals
Add more candlestick pattern detection features such as engulfing patterns, doji, and other classic formations

risk_points: 该EA为纯工具型程序，不执行任何交易操作，无交易风险
需注意警报功能可能导致交易者过度反应，频繁手动进出市场
risk_points_en: This EA is a pure utility program that does not execute any trading operations, posing no trading risk
Be aware that alert functionality may cause traders to overreact and frequently enter/exit the market manually

summary_en: N Candles v4 is a utility indicator/EA for MetaTrader 5 that counts and displays information about N consecutive candles (e.g., consecutive bullish or bearish candles) on the chart. It serves as a visual analytical tool to help traders identify streak patterns in candle sequences rather than executing trades automatically.
